page.overview:
Who is Ruutuu?

Matoka Tribe|Alignment=Evil|Games=Mortal Kombat (2011)}}

Ruutuu is an evil character that appears in Mission #93 "Clarity" of Challenge Tower from the 2011 video game Mortal Kombat.

Ruutuu, an all-black male with glowing blue eyes, is a demonic spirit that has harassed Nightwolf's ancestors. Nightwolf faces Ruutuu in Jade's Desert. Little else is known about him.
